{{Quote|Hey, my ride!|The Twi'lek punk to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] when she stole his bike|<ref name="POP" />}}
A '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] biker''' resided on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A resident of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] thug was dating a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When one of Coruscant's major [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] was [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|bombed]] by agents of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], he and his girlfriend were caught outside during the mass blackout. As they approached his [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] to leave the [[pedwalk]], the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], commandeered the speeder bike as she avoided two [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. As his bike was stolen, all the punk could do was exclaim out loud.<ref name="POP" />
